headline: Approved disbursement for Girdler House generator and extended several project MOUs
summary: The committee reviewed updates on CPA Funding Round 13 applications, including the Central Cemetery Tomb House and Fence and Gates projects, the Beverly Affordable Housing Trust request, and the Garden School roof replacement. It approved a partial fund disbursement for the Girdler House generator project, extended multiple MOUs for ongoing projects, and approved prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Agreed the Girdler House Generator project (OOC-24) can be closed out after contractor issue resolution.
Approved a partial disbursement of $72,812 to the Girdler House for the generator project, 8-0.
Approved extending the Gruppe Mural MOU (R7-8) to October 1, 2026, 8-0.
Approved extending the Abbott Street ROW (R12-1) and Beverly Farms Fence (R12-3 plus R10) MOUs for one year each, to May 29, 2027, 7-0.
Approved extending the Holcroft Park Splashpad (R12-8) and Gillis Park Pavilion (R12-9) MOUs to December 31, 2026, 8-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of December 18, 2025, and January 22, 2026, as amended, 8-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of February 19, 2026, as presented, 8-0.
